data.Subtitle: For men aged between 35-45 years
data.AboutTheTest: Recommended for a detailed health evaluation, including heart & bone health.

DescriptionList.Description: Please arrive 10 minutes before your scheduled appointment
Most tests take approximately 90 minutes, though this may vary depending on the package or test selected.
If you have diabetes, high blood pressure, heart disease, or have recently been ill or had a fever, inform the customer care executive in advance.
Call your care manager or center to reschedule or cancel your appointment.
Bring your medications and the latest prescription if any.
If you have Diabetes/Hypertension take your scheduled medication on the day of the check up.
Bring your medical records from the past 1 month to 3 years on the day of your consultation.
Drink at least 1Litre of water for a full bladder before the scan.
Avoid high-fat meals, snacks, and fried foods 46 hours prior to the scan.
If you have gallbladder problems, undergo the scan while fasting.
Bring any old reports if previously diagnosed with renal or ovarian cysts or prostate enlargement.

related.Subtitle: For Male Above 60 years
related.AboutTheTest: This comprehensive health assessment for senior males evaluates multiple crucial bodily systems. It includes assessments of kidney and liver function, blood sugar control, and cholesterol levels, alongside a detailed blood count and inflammatory marker evaluation. Vitamin levels, thyroid function, and prostate health are also assessed. Imaging techniques like X-rays and ultrasounds provide visual insights into chest and abdominal organs, while cardiac health is evaluated via ECG and echocardiography. Stool and urine analyses offer additional information regarding digestive and urinary tract health.

data.Subtitle: For Male to assess the overall health
data.AboutTheTest: This comprehensive health assessment provides a detailed overview of your overall well-being. It evaluates kidney and liver function, blood health, and cholesterol levels. Additionally, it examines thyroid function, inflammation markers, and blood sugar control. Cardiac health is assessed through an ECG, echocardiogram, and stress test, while prostate health (for males) and ovarian health (for females) are also evaluated. The package further includes imaging of the chest and abdomen, and vitamin level checks, offering a holistic understanding of your current health status

DescriptionList.Description: Please arrive at the allocated clinic 10 minutes before your scheduled appointment
Avoid alcohol & smoking at least 24 hours prior to your pre policy medical check up
Avoid any strenuous activity 24h prior to your check-up.
Please bring all your medications and latest prescription
Please bring all previous reports, treatment records & hospitalisation discharge summary from the past 1 month to 3 years (if any).
If you have diabetes, high blood pressure, heart disease or have recently been ill or had fever, inform the customer care in advance
Keep yourself well hydrated. Drink water 15 to 20 minutes before Ultrasonography. "
